investment_strategy: Cautious-near-term, constructive-long-term A.I. core strategy. With the S&P 500 and NASDAQ down sharply over 30 days, VIX ~22, and 10Y yields at 4.25%, we overweight quality, cash-generative hyperscalers and mission-critical A.I. infrastructure while sizing high-volatility exposure modestly. We prioritize moderate/low volatility, durable earnings/revenue growth, positive momentum, and strong analyst consensus. Position sizing tilts defensive (MSFT as core) with selective upside (GOOGL for faster momentum and ad/Cloud leverage, NVDA for A.I. compute leadership) while acknowledging regulatory, antitrust, and U.S.-China risks. Implementation: staged entries over 2-4 weeks to manage volatility, quarterly rebalance, and trim/add around earnings surprises and policy headlines.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: Quality-weighted A.I. exposure via hyperscalers and core compute with risk-managed sizing in a higher-rate, higher-volatility environment.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Screened for: lower/moderate volatility, strong earnings/revenue growth, positive momentum, and positive analyst consensus; layered with news/regulatory risk, balance sheet quality, and alignment to A.I. infrastructure/hyperscaler demand. Weights reflect macro caution (VIX>20, yields 4.25%) and preference for resilient cash flows.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Near-term choppy given tech pullback and higher yields; long-term constructive on A.I. compute and enterprise adoption. Favor high-quality balance sheets and core A.I. infrastructure while monitoring antitrust, export controls, and power constraints.
